description: This file defines the OnboardingWizardView SwiftUI view and related components for onboarding users in the OpenClaw iOS app, including QR code scanning, manual setup, and connection status management.

classes.name: OnboardingStep
classes.description: An enum representing the different steps in the onboarding process, with computed properties for navigation and display.

classes.name: OnboardingWizardView
classes.description: A SwiftUI view managing the onboarding flow, including QR code scanning, manual setup, and connection status updates.

classes.name: OnboardingModeRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a selectable row for different connection modes during onboarding.

methods.name: handleScannedLink
methods.description: Processes a scanned QR code link to populate connection fields and initiate connection.

methods.name: openQRScannerFromOnboarding
methods.description: Prepares and opens the QR code scanner, stopping active reconnect loops.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApproval
methods.description: Resumes connection attempts after user approval during pairing, managing reconnect logic.

methods.name: resumeAfterPairingApprovalInBackground
methods.description: Resumes pairing approval in background without UI flicker.

methods.name: attemptAutomaticPairingResumeIfNeeded
methods.description: Automatically attempts to resume pairing if conditions are met, with throttling.

methods.name: detectQRCode
methods.description: Detects and extracts a QR code message from image data.

methods.name: advanceFromIntro
methods.description: Marks first run intro as seen and advances to the next onboarding step.

methods.name: navigateBack
methods.description: Navigates to the previous onboarding step.

methods.name: connectDiscoveredGateway
methods.description: Initiates connection to a discovered gateway.

methods.name: selectMode
methods.description: Selects a connection mode and applies default settings.

methods.name: applyModeDefaults
methods.description: Applies default host, port, and TLS settings based on selected mode.

methods.name: gatewayHasResolvableHost
methods.description: Checks if a gateway has a resolvable host address.

methods.name: connectManual
methods.description: Attempts manual connection to specified host and port.

methods.name: retryLastAttempt
methods.description: Retries the last connection attempt, optionally silently.

methods.name: initializeState
methods.description: Initializes onboarding state from stored settings and defaults.

methods.name: scheduleDiscoveryRestart
methods.description: Schedules a restart of gateway discovery after a delay.

methods.name: saveGatewayCredentials
methods.description: Saves gateway token and password to persistent storage.

methods.name: saveGatewayBootstrapToken
methods.description: Saves bootstrap token for gateway connection.
